integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the source definitions and theorem statement. The repair uses the closed graph theorem, and the sharpness examples are explicit scalar models. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The constants are universal functions only of \(B_0\) and \(M\); a specific family can have better optimal bounds. For \(MB_0>1\), sharpness of the upper constant is by an approaching two-atom family.
title: Closed-graph repair and optimal bounds for a resolution-of-identity g-fusion criterion
